I am sorry to read that you are finding it difficult to see a GP at the Harwood/Tonge Moor site. I understand your frustration with the current situation and appreciate you taking the time to provide feedback.
Due to funding changes within the NHS, we are encouraged to work collaboratively with other practices in our area. This collaboration is known as Turton PCN and comprises 6 practices, including Harwood/Tonge Moor. The funding is used to provide additional appointments to practices to deal with the increased demands on our services. You may have been offered an appointment in our PCN as these are usually available sooner than those available in practice and are appropriate for your ailment.

I have tried to contact you this morning to discuss your concerns and organise an appointment if that is what you require. We value your health and well-being, and we want to ensure you receive the care you need.
Thank you again for sharing your experience. Your feedback helps us improve our services.

Kind Regards,

Mrs Sophie Whitehead
